title: CPU and memory metrics
summary: Every service now has a metrics view showing CPU and memory usage over time.
body_markdown:
[Home](https://simplifyd.com/) /


[Changelog](https://simplifyd.com/changelog) /


CPU and memory metrics


We sample usage every minute and keep thirty days of history. Open the metrics tab on any service to see per-pod CPU and memory, over ranges from the last hour to the last month.
